theorems.name: Submission.cmcsdtd_mass_controls_eval
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n), (Tendsto (fun j => (X j).mass) atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Tendsto (fun j => X j ω) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∑' j, (X j).mass < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Summable (fun j => X j ω)) ∧ ∀ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun j => X j ω) (Y ω)) → Y.mass ≤ ∑' j, (X j).mass)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
